scientific_question: Does assignment structure matter when historical domains share one output space, and does replay performance vary as assignment variance is reduced at fixed conditional-mean supervision?

interpretation.analysis_role: outcome-informed but prospectively locked explanatory follow-up
interpretation.shared_output_structure_primary: Permuted-MNIST domain-IL across-domain minus within-domain final accuracy
interpretation.variance_ladder_primary: Within each benchmark, final accuracy across K=1,4,16,infinity at nominal lambda 0.75

shared_output_structure.reference_implementation: the same audited wrapper with replay storage and replay loss disabled

intervention.historical_definition: a buffered row whose stored domain ID is smaller than the current domain ID
intervention.atom: four replay rows: two rows from each of two distinct historical domains, with four distinct target values
intervention.selection: counter-keyed random candidate priority followed by deterministic greedy disjoint atom selection; the rule uses only row labels, stored domain IDs, observation index, and locked counter keys
intervention.within_domain: transpose the two target sources inside each domain pair
intervention.across_domain: exchange the two domain-pair target blocks with a counter-keyed orientation

inference.primary_estimand: across_domain minus within_domain final domain-IL average accuracy in percentage points
inference.primary_interval: two-sided Student-t 95 percent paired interval over six fresh run seeds
secondary_estimands: final shared-output negative log likelihood for every arm and the same paired contrasts

intervention.finite_k: draw K independent supports and K independent within-support permutations, convert every draw to one-hot targets, and average those K targets before one forward/backward update
intervention.infinity: use the exact conditional mean over both random support selection and within-support permutation
intervention.optimizer_and_schedule: Mammoth benchmark defaults except the explicitly locked learning rate and epoch count
intervention.common_state_identity: the raw gradient of the finite-K average target equals the arithmetic mean of the K raw hard-target gradients, up to a locked floating-point tolerance

primary_outputs: K=1 minus infinity and each intermediate minus infinity
ordered accuracy trajectory in 1/K without a monotonicity claim
inference.linear_theory_prediction: conditional assignment covariance and finite-horizon excess quadratic risk scale as 1/K under the stated linear assumptions
inference.neural_interpretation: fixed conditional mean with reduced finite-K assignment variance; monotone accuracy is an empirical hypothesis

execution.queue_order: all shared-output structure units before all variance-ladder units
